HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:AHC:88707 Court No. - 64 Case :- CRIMINAL MISC. BAIL APPLICATION No. - 13744 of 2024 Applicant :- Saurabh Kumar Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Nishant Dwivedi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Matter is taken up in the revised call.

By means of this bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
08 of 2024 at Police Station Jaithara, District Etah under Sections 376 I.P.C.
The applicant is in jail since 26.02.2024.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 19.03.2024.

The following arguments made by Shri Nishant Dwivedi, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Ashish Kumar Ojha, learned AGA from the record,
entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Saurabh Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84563969/

sentences.text: 1. The victim is the widow of the applicant's brother.
2. After the death of his brother, the applicant and the victim became intimate.
3. Subsequently, the victim and the applicant got married.
One baby girl was born in the wedlock.
4. The FIR is a result of the matrimonial dispute between the parties.
5. False and aggravated allegations have been made against the applicant by the victim at the instigation of some interested parties.
6. Medical evidence to corroborate commission of rape by the applicant with the victim has not been produced by the prosecution.
7. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
8. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Saurabh Kumar be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

The learned trial court is directed to fix the sureties after due application of mind in light of the judgement passed by this Court in Arvind Singh v. State of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt.
(Application U/S 482 No.2613 of 2023).
The learned trial court shall ensure that the right of bail of the applicant granted by this Court is not frustrated by arbitrary demands of sureties, or onerous conditions which are unrelated to the socioeconomic status of the applicant.
Order Date :- 16.5.2024 Vandit  Saurabh Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84563969/
